final: WITH by_type AS (SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tx.transreg) AS trans_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref GROUP BY tr.tradekind), total AS (SELECT SUM(trans_count) AS total_count FROM by_type) SELECT by_type.tradekind, by_type.trans_count, CAST(by_type.trans_count AS REAL) / total.total_count FROM by_type CROSS JOIN total WHERE total.total_count IS NOT NULL
